purpose: Measure the application full-resolution PLY ingest path on an available derived dataset; this is not an alignment or structural-accuracy validation.
notes: The input is the existing derived stitched PLY, not an RCS file. The two-station registration manifest remains explicitly unverified, so this run establishes only parser/ingest throughput, completeness for this PLY, source integrity, and sampled resource use.
Peak RSS and minimum free disk were sampled every 0.2 seconds and may miss a shorter peak. Output disk size is measured after successful ingest.
The available 43.5-million-point PLY does not satisfy the plan's full original-source acceptance gate. A full FARO-source route and cancellation/restart at this scale remain open.
